description:
This image shows a city square bathed in dramatic lighting, likely at sunset or sunrise, with long shadows cast on the cobblestone ground. The square is populated with pigeons in the foreground and a group of people further away in the background, giving a sense of depth. Buildings and street lamps frame the scene, with the silhouetted outline of classic European-style architecture, including a distinctively shaped tower on the right side.

In the sky, there are many birds flying, adding movement to the peaceful cityscape scene. The cloud cover is textured, and the sun is low on the horizon, providing a strong backlight that emphasizes silhouettes.

On the right edge of the image, there are clear visual distortions or artifacts—vertical bands of colored blocks and lines (red, blue, orange, yellow, green, and white), along with some pixelation. This is consistent with file corruption or digital damage, as referenced in the context (“Uszkodzenia widoczne w odtworzonym pliku graficznym”—visible damage in the restored graphic file). This corrupted part overlays part of the image, obscuring part of the content in that area. The rest of the image is in grayscale, contrasting with the colorful damaged strip.
